title: Sales Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

SALES MANAGER

**What we believe in**

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will meet both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also

showcase your ability by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite.

The role You will be working as Sales Specialist for Sales Function and you will support for the Electrification Smart Buildings Business, to be based at Hubli, Karnataka, India.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

  

* Channel Management: Establish and manage primary & secondary distributor networks; regularly engage distributors, dealers, and retailers; facilitate growth and manage receivables.
* Sales Performance: Reach monthly, quarterly, and yearly sales targets; manage primary, secondary, and tertiary sales within the assigned territory.
* Marketing & Promotions: Plan and execute promotional activities such as retailer meets, product seminars, roadshows, exhibitions, and in-shop branding.
* Trade Schemes: Design and implement product promotion schemes for distributors, retailers, and customers, both directly and through distribution channels.
* Coordination & Reporting: Coordinate with team leaders and stakeholders; prepare and submit daily and monthly sales and activity reports.

**Qualifications for the role:**

  

* Experience in Modular Switches, MCB, RCCB, and Distribution Boards (DB).
* Educational Qualification: Any graduate; MBA.
* Work Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in Retail Sales and Distribution.
* Distributor Management: Comprehensive knowledge and direct experience in managing distributor networks.
* Product Launches: Capable of planning and executing new product launches effectively.
* Marketing & Promotions: Ability to conduct promotional marketing activities, branding initiatives, and design product schemes.
* Planning & Communication: Effective day-to-day activity planning and reporting with proficient communication and relationship management skills.

**More about us**

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: SALES ADMIN ASSOCIATE / EXECUTIVE
description:
Reporting To

Sales Head / HR Manager

Job Summary

The Sales Backend Executive will be responsible for managing sales data, preparing MIS reports, coordinating with the sales team, supporting administrative activities, and ensuring smooth backend operations. The role requires strong analytical skills, excellent coordination abilities, and proficiency in MS Excel and reporting tools.

Key Responsibilities

Administration

 Maintain office records and documentation.

 Coordinate courier, stationery, and office supplies.

 Handle travel bookings and accommodation for employees.

 Maintain filing systems and official records.

 Coordinate meetings, training sessions, and internal communication.

 Support day\-to\-day administrative activities.

Sales MIS \& Data Management

 Prepare Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Sales MIS Reports.

 Maintain accurate sales records and databases.

 Generate sales performance reports for management.

 Update customer, dealer, and distributor databases.

 Track sales targets, achievements, and pending orders.

 Ensure data accuracy and timely reporting.

 Coordinate with Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), Area Sales Managers (ASMs), Sales Officers, and Sales Executives.

 Follow up on sales reports, attendance, tour plans, and expense submissions.

 Maintain proper documentation related to sales operations.

 Support communication between Sales, Accounts, HR, and Operations teams.

Reporting

 Prepare Daily Sales Reports (DSR).

 Generate Monthly Sales Performance Reports.

 Prepare attendance and expense reports for the sales team.

 Maintain dealer and distributor performance reports.

 Submit management reports within defined timelines.

 Analyze sales trends and highlight key observations.

Preferred Candidate Profile

 Strong proficiency in MS Excel and reporting.

 Excellent follow\-up and coordination skills.

 Detail\-oriented with strong analytical abilities.

 Professional communication and interpersonal skills.

 Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle multiple tasks efficiently.
